subject: New MCAS Accountability System and District Ratings
overview: The committee reviewed Medford's first ratings under the new state MCAS accountability system and accepted a $125,000 donation from the Crystal Campbell Foundation. They also discussed staffing shortages in after-school programs and the budgetary rollout of a new K-5 science curriculum.

items.title: Routine Approvals and Playground Maintenance
items.summary: Approved amended meeting minutes, bills including slide repairs at Columbus Elementary, and established a schedule for biannual payroll updates.

items.title: Report of the Secretary
items.summary: Ms. Kreatz reported on summer playground inspections, volunteer maintenance projects at various schools, and the status of PTO registration forms.

items.title: Philanthropist Event at Chevalier Theatre
items.summary: Ken Krause invited the community to a talk by Medford alumnus and philanthropist Bill Cummings at the Chevalier Theatre.

items.title: Superintendent Updates
items.summary: Dr. Edouard-Vincent reported on elementary math learning walks, middle school classroom visits, and the successful handling of a medical incident at the high school.

items.title: MCAS Accountability System Overview
items.summary: Officials presented the new state grading metrics, noting that Brooks Elementary is 'meeting targets' while the district and other schools are 'partially meeting targets.'

items.title: Before and After School Programs Report
items.summary: The committee reviewed a 30% enrollment increase in after-school programs and voted to investigate waiving training fees for new hires to alleviate staffing shortages.

items.title: New Superintendent Induction Program
items.summary: Dr. Carla Baer introduced the three-year mentoring program designed to support the superintendent’s transition and district strategy development.

items.title: FOSS Science Program Rollout
items.summary: The committee discussed the $250,000 two-year budget for the hands-on Full Option Science System (FOSS) curriculum for elementary grades.

items.title: District Enrollment Report
items.summary: Associate Superintendent Caldwell reported a total enrollment of 4,218 students and noted continued growth in the English Learner population.

items.title: Crystal Campbell Gift Agreement
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of a $125,000 perpetual donation from the Crystal Campbell Foundation to support the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility.

items.title: Resolutions and New Business
items.summary: The committee honored the memory of former member George D. White Jr. and others, while noting upcoming requests for reports on security and homeschooling.
